message: 清楚を嗅ぎ分ける者
After going to return last month's milk bottles to Old Man Amakawa--

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
Just as I approach the school gate, I run into a familiar face.
If I remember right, he's...

name: Man
message: 「Oh my, well, well. If it isn't you, the Student Council President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much for attending KiraFes the other day.」

name: Man
message: 「Thank you for your courtesy.」
My delivery was subtly monotone, though he doesn't seem to notice.

name: Man
message: 「I may look like a gentle soul, yet I am surprisingly big on duty and human kindness, you see. Oh, how embarrassing to admit.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, what are you doing here?」

name: Man
message: 「I thought I would express my gratitude and thanks to all the lovely ladies I met at the recent event...」
In his hands, various tributes are prepared.

name: Synn
message: 「Today is a holiday, so school is closed.」

name: Man
message: 「Haha. So it is. I finally understand why only diligent and pure young ladies were passing through.」
I don't know who he's referring to, but it doesn't seem like a problem for now.

name: Man
message: 「Excuse me, Student Council President--」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, um, I'm... My name is Synn Sakura.」

name: Man
message: 「Synn Sakura! How sweet and dazzling a ring that name has!」
I'm not really happy about that description.

name: Synn
message: 「If you don't mind, may I have your name as well?」

name: Melphas
message: 「I am called Melphas. Please do remember me from this day forward.」
Alright. Now I can update my suspicious person list.

name: Melphas
message: 「Now then, Student Council President.」
He really insists on calling me that, it seems.

name: Melphas
message: 「To you, who sits enthroned at the pinnacle of this academy, there is something I simply must ask.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no, it's nothing like that.\s03」

name: Melphas
message: 「Could you please tell me who the loveliest woman in this academy is--the one whom roses suit best?」
Should I take that to mean someone with thorns?

name: Synn
message: 「I believe a woman named Helena Kujou who lives in that mansion over there would be a very good match.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Is that so? Thank you very much. Well then, until we meet again.」
He leaves, sending rose petals fluttering in his wake.
With this, none of our students should fall victim to him.
Now then, I should head to the Student Council room too.

name: Melphas
message: 「WAGYAAAH!!」

name: Synn
message: 「That was fast!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh! Welcome! I'm the first one here! Let's play cards until everyone gets here!」

name: Synn
message: 「What part of you is a diligent, proper young lady...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Excuse me?」
